thread:
alex: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need a compact action tracker for the vendor outage (cloud auth + model-registry retries + fallback routing). Can owners call dibs?

maya: I can take the cloud auth hardening items.

alex: Awesome — specifically: add circuit-breaker on auth calls, tighten retry backoff, and run a 72h smoke test on staging. ETA?

maya: ETA 2 weeks for config + 1 week for smoke test. I'll open a PR with config changes by EOD tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

tj: I'll own model-registry mitigations — add local registry cache and requeue logic for transient 502s. Need help from infra for storage sizing.

olivia: I'll help with sizing. Quick question: do we prefer in-memory LRU or small persistent cache?

tj: persistent (rocksdb) with capped size, simpler for restarts. I'll draft a design doc.

alex: Great. For fallback routing (route to smaller quantized variant when primary backend is unhealthy) — who owns policies?

rachael: I can take routing rules + rollout policy. Plan: implement feature-flagged fallback in canary, measure latency delta, then enable for Dedicated tiers first.

jamal: infra-bot: deploy-check for yesterday's smoke run failed at 03:12 UTC due to auth 429s. Reporting here for visibility.

sam-infra-bot: [auto] incident: auth-provider-rate-limit triggered 03:12 UTC, 14m duration, automatic fallback not configured.

alex: Action summary (I'll paste as checklist for PRs/owners):
```
- maya: auth circuit-breaker + retry tuning -> PR by TOM EOD, rollout W/ smoke test (due: 2026-04-08)
- tj: model-registry persistent cache + requeue -> design doc by 2026-04-05, impl by 2026-04-19
- olivia: storage sizing + perf validation for registry cache -> input by 2026-04-07
- rachael: fallback routing feature flag + canary -> plan by 2026-04-09, canary 2026-04-15
- alex: compile weekly status + escalate SLAs with vendor if no progress by 2026-04-10
```

maya: Noted. I'll tag infra and security on the PR for review. @olivia want me to include suggested KMS names?

olivia: yes pls include KMS + least-priv roles.

tj: putting a short eval harness in the registry PR to catch regressions.

rachael: will add telemetry hooks to measure fallback hit-rate + quality regression flags.

alex: Recurring pattern note: this is the 3rd auth-provider blip in 6 months. If mitigations don't reduce incidents, we'll escalate contract terms / introduce an alternative provider. Documenting here so PMs & legal can follow.

maya: Agreed. I'll draft a vendor escalation email template and share.

jamal: pinging support squad to add this to weekly ops review.

alex: OK — schedule weekly 15m check-in, Mondays 09:30 PT starting next week to review progress and telemetry. If anyone hits blockers earlier call them out in this thread. :rocket:

olivia: noted, I'll add calendar invite. :calendar:

rachael: small ask — can we add a single issue tracker (one source of truth) for these items? I can consolidate into a tracking ticket and post updates here.

alex: Yes please — create a single GH issue and paste link here once created. That will be our canonical tracker.

maya: GH issue created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/issues/458 — added checklist and owners.

alex: Perfect. Closing this thread for triage; reopen if anything changes. Thanks everyone. :pray:
